data.Effect: Effect: This is a crystalline object that can capture a Fainted or Willing Pokemon, putting them in a stasis similar to a Pokeball. The Pokemon inside cannot be released from this Item unless it is destroyed. The Pokemon inside gains the Telepath Capability but can only communicate with their holder, and vice versa. For each Burst Heart a Trainer has in their Inventory or Equipped, their Pokemon Party size is reduced by -1. The Pokemon contained in this Item has its own Stat Sheet that must be tracked and they may Level Up as normal. The contained Pokemon may allow another creature to enter their Burst Heart and interact with them normally, such as Training them or teaching them Tutor Attacks. This Item cannot be Disarmed if the holder is in their associated Burst Form. [Large] [Equipment]
